concepts.title: Claribel the Canary in the Space Station
concepts.section: Feathered Friend, Let us read I
concepts.definition: Sven Olsen smuggles a small yellow canary named Claribel aboard a space station; she weighs almost nothing, learns to glide in zero gravity with lazy flicks, and becomes the crew's general pet hidden from visiting VIPs.
concepts.key_idea: A bird adapted to weightlessness shows how life bends to new rules; Claribel does no unnecessary work in free fall.
concepts.textbook_ref: hepr105.txt, Feathered Friend, Let us read I

concepts.title: The Canary that Saved the Crew
concepts.section: Feathered Friend, Let us read II
concepts.definition: When Claribel faints and revives only under an oxygen mask, the narrator remembers that miners once carried canaries to warn of gas; the frozen air purifier and its silent alarm are found, and the bird proves a life-saving sentinel.
concepts.key_idea: Old wisdom meets new machines: a tiny bird catches the failure that half a million dollars of engineering missed.
concepts.textbook_ref: hepr105.txt, Feathered Friend, Let us read II

solution_steps.explain: Note Claribel's collapse and her brief recovery under the oxygen mask.
Connect the canary to the miners' custom of testing air for gas.
Trace the frozen purifier and the unconnected second alarm to the danger.

concepts.title: Life in Zero Gravity
concepts.definition: The story sketches space routine: twelve-hour watches in permanent sunlight, bunk straps, weightless girders assembled in slow-motion ballet, and a 150-pound bonus for light workers, showing how a station crew lives and works.
concepts.key_idea: Everyday habits, waking, breakfast, work, change shape in orbit, where there is no day, night or weight.
concepts.textbook_ref: hepr105.txt, Feathered Friend, Let us read

concepts.title: Word Meanings: Wiry, Cubbyhole and Bulkheads
concepts.definition: Space-story words fix themselves in context: wiry means thin but strong, a cubbyhole is a small enclosed space, bulkheads are dividing walls between compartments, and keeled over means collapsed or fainted.
concepts.key_idea: Technical words like girders, ventilating shafts and intercom make the station feel real.
concepts.textbook_ref: hepr105.txt, Feathered Friend, Let us learn
